title: The Maharashtra Textile Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1982.
full_text: The Maharashtra Textile Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1982. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198233 Act Number: 33 Enactment Date: 1982-10-14 Act Year: 1982 Short Title: The Maharashtra Textile Companies (Acquisition and Transfer of Undertakings) Act, 1982. Long Title: An Act to provide for the acquisition of undertakings of two textile companies for the purpose of ensuring continued and increased production of goods essential to the needs of the country and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
